interpretation: initial study targets; allowance=max(relative*scale,absolute); not empirical accuracy claims
information: action t sees weather and state through t; plant sees t+1; only causal persistence available, no future reanalysis forecast
experimental_split_unit: rain event / entire experimental run / PV day; locked before fitting
cold_scope: cold/snow excluded from cassette control; independent phase-change reference does not qualify full product
claims_gate: experimental support, numerical verification, emulator accuracy and controller ranking are distinct gates
prior_uncertainty: randomization ranges are sensitivity scenarios, not calibrated probability distributions
